core_obligations: Form the fibre product T' = F x_G T and read off the flat, locally finitely presented, surjective morphism T' -> T (proof lines 906-910).
Conclude that T' -> T is an fppf covering and that g pulls back into the image of F(T') (proof lines 910-913).
Apply the definition of surjectivity for maps of sheaves (proof lines 913-914).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for sheaves F, G on (Sch/S)_{fppf} and a transformation a : F -> G which is representable, flat, locally of finite presentation and surjective, the transformation is surjective as a map of sheaves (source lines 897-904). The proof takes an arbitrary T-valued point g of G, forms the fibre product T' = F x_G T - a scheme by representability - observes that T' -> T is flat, locally finitely presented and surjective, hence an fppf covering, and that g restricted to T' comes from the projection T' -> F.
